## Design

### 2026-10-09 – # DAY 1 (Friday):

**4h**

# DAY 1 (Friday):

Today I started my first project for Hackclub HalfLife. Because Meta recently announced an **open Source SDK for the Esp32** for their [AI Muse](https://gadgets.muse.ai/), I thought that it might be cool to build a gadget that uses this sdk.

Even though I'm not fully new to pcb design, I also **wouldn't call myself experienced**. That's why I actually was impressed how easy it was to wire the schematic.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/57hiQNAgkNbxG5Q8GjhzMk9nORrt5I37/82603bc975c1965985569b388281a8b46e5991249c274dd056bc2e4b2064842f.png)

One small problem I had was that I **couldn't find any SH1106 librarys for KiCad** but luckily I could just use a generic Interface Symbol with VCC, GND, SDA and SCL.

I also assigned the footprints to the symbols, which actually was kinda challenging because I had to import the Library for the xiao esp32

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/57hiQNAgkNbxG5Q8GjhzMk9nORrt5I37/cf05ab51f927bc6cfc65a377beaeba51a79a2014ec0279a32df6e36721623939.png)

This is the finished result now in the PCB-Editor. YIPPIIEEH 🥳🥳🥳:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/57hiQNAgkNbxG5Q8GjhzMk9nORrt5I37/bb066cef3231be00efd1348076d8c85909e09d5d890aa7f62d8dd4b754229020.png)

Before I start the next steps of the design I wanted to **brainstorm a bit on the form factor**. Here's a small drawing I drew to brainstorm ideas:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/57hiQNAgkNbxG5Q8GjhzMk9nORrt5I37/e850334c18475ea3e8193a737b35c919c389fb1301f05fe02a22a3ea8d671dd9.png)

Overall I am pretty happy with my progress and I am looking forward to **the next design steps**
